qs.s: Ce peintre est très ___ : il invente sans cesse de nouvelles formes artistiques.
qs.en: This painter is very creative: he constantly invents new artistic forms.

qs.s: Les enfants sont naturellement ___ et imaginent des histoires extraordinaires.
qs.en: Children are naturally creative and imagine extraordinary stories.

qs.en: They adopted a creative approach to solve this complex problem.

qs.s: Ce projet repose sur un processus ___ qui associe art et technologie.
qs.en: This project is based on a creative process that combines art and technology.

qs.s: Ces architectes sont reconnus comme les esprits les plus ___ de leur génération.
qs.en: These architects are recognized as the most creative minds of their generation.

qs.en: His students are creative: they invent original solutions for every exercise.

qs.en: She has a creative imagination that allows her to design unique projects.

qs.en: The creative ideas of this team led to a major innovation.

qs.en: The two companies signed a cooperation agreement to develop this project together.

qs.en: We waited in the queue for more than an hour before going in.

qs.en: The customers were queueing outside the bakery from opening time.

qs.en: The schoolchildren walk in single file along the corridor.

qs.en: The document has been stuck in the print queue since this morning.

qs.en: The server manages requests through a processing queue.

qs.s: ___ file devant la caisse était interminable.

qs.s: Il s'est formé ___ longue file devant le guichet.
qs.en: A long queue formed in front of the counter.
